public.text: Mandatory national datasets may create barriers for people or facilities unable to provide every required attribute. This is especially relevant to identity, address, contact, nationality, and credential data.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish mandatory schema support from mandatory presence in every record. Define conditional, unknown, unavailable, provisional, and not-applicable states and ensure missing data does not automatically prevent essential service access.
